newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares seen weakening on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares seen weakening on Thursday.

text.p: Singapore shares were seen tracking negative territory on Thursday with investors jittery over earnings potential for blue chips and sidelined with currency concerns, a dealer said.
"Clients have got the jitters about earnings and the currency problems have caused a stand-off in the stock market," the dealer with a local institution said.
The Straits Times Industrials Index closed weaker, ending off 10.69 points at 1,966.41 on Wednesday, weighed down mainly by worries that the Singapore property market could face a slump.
Trading activity on Thursday was again seen focused on the small cap and electronics stocks popular with retail punters, the dealer said.
